excerpts: Data Overview: two major release components (Household + Insurance); 1996 Nursing Home Component restricted-only. HC: online pubs/tools/variable explorer/summary tables/downloadable PUFs + documentation/codebooks; restricted HC files via Data Center/FSRDCs (approved projects). MPC: Data-Center-only, editing/imputation use for HC only, no standalone files, not national estimates. IC: online tabular/tools only - no public data files (confidentiality); FSRDC research-version list-sample files for approved projects. No cost, account, pricing, or DUA-execution terms stated on this page; authorization forms live under MPC questionnaires.
